args.title: Fix BOM prepended to CSV exports causing corrupted header
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

Change the default behavior to not prepend a byte order mark (BOM) to CSV exports. The current default (bom option true) causes the first column header to appear corrupted in some CSV readers.

label: bug
file: src/export/csv.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The file src/export/csv.ts currently prepends a byte order mark (BOM) by default to CSV exports, which causes the first column header to appear corrupted in some CSV readers. Changing the default to not prepend the BOM will fix the reported issue.
